snippet.title: Stick Knight - The RPG. First 5 Minutes of Gameplay.
snippet.description:
Proud to unveil the first 5 minutes of gameplay of my very first game: Stick Knight - The RPG. After many years of hobby game dev, I dedicated the past 9 months creating my first completed game. With 10 different zones, 4 bosses, and many unique enemies and weapons to fight them with, this is a short but fun adventure to tackle over a weekend.

Play today from my itch.io page: https://ravdi-games.itch.io/stick-knight-the-rpg
